about.text: Mimolette is a cheese traditionally produced around the city of Lille, France. In France it is also known as boule de Lille after its city of origin, or vieux Hollande because it was originally inspired by the Dutch Edam cheese.

how.label: mite-ripen
how.text: Mimolette is a washed-curd pressed cheese coloured with annatto and shaped into a ball; during a long cave ripening the rind is colonised by cheese mites and regularly brushed and turned, giving a dry, hard, pitted crust. Long ageing concentrates its aroma and hardens the paste.

steps.note: Up to 0.35 mL per litre, for the orange colour.
Into a sphere flattened at the poles, 2–4 kg.
Turned and brushed; vieille ripens 13 mo or more, extra-vieille 18.
